title: Teaching clarinet and composition in his 48th Street studio
summary: He opened a studio over Manny's, took overflow students from his teacher, and taught students such as Kermit Lavinsky.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: I was teaching clarinet and composition. And I had some good students like Bill Verplank (PHONETIC), he started with me. And several others. The fellow that died, his brother's a saxophone player here now. He studied with me. What was the saxophone player, the red fellow, that

Yeah, well, his brother Kermit Lavinsky. He studied with me and he was a fine tenor player. But he studied composition with me and he finally ended up in Hollywood writing for movies and pictures and everything. But he committed suicide a few years ago.
